name: Page
description: Represents a page in a document. Use the Page object and the related methods and properties for programmatically defining page layout in a document.
remarks: Use the Item method to access a specific page in a document. The following example accesses the first page in the active document. To access the page number, use the Information property of a Range or Selection object, or the PageIndex property of a Break object that belongs to the Breaks collection of the specified Page object. The Top and Left properties of the Page object always return 0 (zero) indicating the upper-left corner of the page. The Height and Width properties return the height and width in points (72 points = 1 inch) of the paper size specified in the Page Setup dialog or through the PageSetup object. For example, for an 8-1/2 by 11 inch page in portrait mode, the Height property returns 792 and the Width property returns 612. All four of these properties are read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Page object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the left edge of the page. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the top edge of the page. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the width, in points, of the paper defined in the Page Setup dialog box. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the height of a page, in pixels.

properties.name: Rectangles
properties.description: Returns a Rectangles collection that represents a portion of text or graphics in a page in a document.

properties.name: Breaks
properties.description: Returns a Breaks collection that represents the breaks on a page. .

properties.name: EnhMetaFileBits
properties.description: Returns a Variant that represents a picture representation of how a page of text appears. Read-only.
